_note: WO-293 tiered gear + legendary reforge recipes (Forgemasters' Saga). outputGearId references an existing id in weapons.json / armor.json; tier scales its base stat via GearTierTable.StatMultiplier (Common 1.0 / Fine 1.25 / Master 1.6 / Legendary 2.2). cost spends the unified wallet (EconomyService.TrySpend -> GameState for crystals/food). components are inventory-keyed ids consumed on craft (e.g. the four legendary components). requiresQuestId locks a recipe until QuestService.IsCompleted (legendary gates on Act IV: forgemasters_act4). Dual-copied: StreamingAssets source + Resources copy (Resources WINS at load in WebGL via CanonicalJson). Keep both in sync.
